name: knowforge
description: AI-powered knowledge base - compile knowledge, not just store it

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @knowforge/shared build && pnpm --filter @knowforge/server build && pnpm --filter @knowforge/web build
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/server/dist apps/web/dist packages/shared/dist apps/server/node_modules apps/web/node_modules packages/shared/node_modules node_modules
